collection.description: An old training exercise has become a children's game played with padded sticks.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: An old training exercise has become a children's game played with padded sticks, in which tapping a shoulder counts as a point and nobody is ever struck. Elders recognize the steps and teach the children the old names for them.
